headline: Repair response truth and finish the pending website release

items.title: Handle empty, truncated and JSON Oracle responses honestly
items.insight: Parse cached JSON replies directly and require nonempty SSE text with the service completion tail. Keep the existing fallback and request policy while verifying success and failure without provider calls. Do not count empty output as a successful answer.

items.title: Separate active arc identity from last closed session in startup
items.insight: Show the active arc separately from the last completed session using the existing identity helper. Preserve ahead-of-SIL state and verify active, absent and stale locks. Regenerate and validate the actual startup brief.

items.title: Review and correct three proven stale Linux reference cells
items.insight: Inspect only the three selected original Linux reference cells after the exact artifact trust decision. Preserve old images and failures, and require unchanged native comparison to pass. Generation or transport alone is not acceptance.

items.title: Complete isolated account acceptance and authorized release promotion
items.insight: Finish actual isolated staging and affected account journeys before production promotion. Verify exact candidate checks, current staging, rollback and served readback under existing deployment authorization. Unresolved trust and registration prerequisites remain pending.
